an7.39:1.1: sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.39:1.3: idha bhikkhave sāriputto idamme cetaso līnattanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an7.39:1.4: ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ me saṅkhittaṃ cittanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an7.39:1.5: bahiddhā vā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ bahiddhā me vikkhittaṃ cittanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an7.39:1.6: tassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
an7.39:1.7: viditā saññā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti viditā
an7.39:1.8: vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
an7.39:1.9: sappāyāsappāyesu kho panassa dhammesu hīnappaṇītesu kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgesu cittaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
an7.39:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
